title: Hermes Capability Expansion — 16 high-leverage tools beyond MEMORY-VAULT (execution/eval/Obsidian-plugin/Qdrant-advanced/Excel-PSN/distribution)
derived_from: user directive 2026-05-24: find more high-leverage zebra/hermes tools; add Excel to PSN

units.title: Tool-use trace replay — Hermes Atlas pattern, replay any dispatcher round-trip
units.description: Today every dispatcher action emits to `prism_session:audit_log` but there is no replay path. Hermes Atlas records every (tool_call, input, output, latency) tuple and replays them deterministically for debugging + regression detection. Build `traceReplayEngine` + `prism_session:trace_replay` action that takes a trace-id and re-executes the same dispatcher call against current code. Operator gets a diff against the original output.
units.exit_criteria: engine + dispatcher action + ≥4 tests (1 happy, 1 idempotent, 1 input-drift, 1 missing-trace)
units.estimated_loc: ~150 LOC engine + ~50 LOC dispatcher wire + ~80 LOC tests

units.title: Schema-aware structured output — Zod-validated tool-call returns on every dispatcher
units.description: Hermes Schema mode enforces JSON-schema validation on every tool input AND output. PRISM has Zod schemas on dispatcher INPUTS (z.enum action lists) but not on OUTPUTS — engines return arbitrary objects, callers must trust shape. Build `dispatchValidator` middleware that wraps every dispatcher's response in a `safeParse` against a per-action output schema. R12 fail-soft: schema miss logs + degrades to raw response with `validated:false` flag. Per-dispatcher rollout starts with `prism_calc` (highest physics-safety leverage).
units.exit_criteria: middleware + ≥10 per-action output schemas across prism_calc + prism_safety + ≥8 tests
units.estimated_loc: ~200 LOC middleware + ~150 LOC schemas + ~100 LOC tests

units.title: Cost telemetry per turn — Hermes Atlas $/tokens/latency per dispatcher call
units.description: Today `ollama-offload-stats.json` tracks offload ratio but not per-turn Claude cost. Build `costLedgerEngine` that observes every `aiSystemRouterEngine.route()` invocation, records (turn_id, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, est_usd, latency_ms, dispatcher), persists to `state/shared/cost-ledger.jsonl`. Operator dashboard via `prism_session:cost_summary` action — by slot / by dispatcher / by date-range. Sister surface to ollama-offload stats.
units.exit_criteria: engine + dispatcher action + Stop-hook flush + ≥3 stats tests + sample 7-day rollup

units.title: Self-correction / thought rewriter — when a dispatch fails, rewrite the plan
units.description: Hermes self-correct: on tool-call failure (schema mismatch, exception, low-confidence result), the agent rewrites its plan + retries. PRISM today: failures surface via Stop hooks (`error-pattern-promote`, `error-block-prewarn`) but no in-loop rewriter. Build `thoughtRewriterEngine` that consumes a failed trace from U-HCAP01, classifies failure (schema-miss / null-result / R12-degrade / wrong-tool), proposes 1-3 alternative dispatcher calls, surfaces to caller. NEVER auto-retries — operator-gated promote.
units.exit_criteria: engine + integration with traceReplay + 4 failure-class tests + advisory dispatcher action

units.title: Eval harness vs Hermes baselines — continuous benchmark suite
units.description: Hermes Eval is a quarterly benchmark across memory recall / tool-use accuracy / plan-completion. PRISM has scrutiny gates (3-of-3) but no continuous benchmark vs external baselines. Build `prism_eval` dispatcher with 5 actions: `bench_memory_recall` (master_index_query top-K precision over a curated 50-query set), `bench_tool_use` (dispatcher round-trip success on a curated 100-task suite), `bench_plan_completion` (milestone-progress drift over time), `bench_cost_per_correct` (U-HCAP03 ledger + correctness signal), `bench_summary` (rollup all 4 + percentile vs baseline). Curated suites under `state/shared/eval-suites/`. Weekly cron run; results to `state/shared/dashboards/eval-results-{week}.{md,html}`.
units.exit_criteria: dispatcher + 5 actions + 4 curated suite files + cron task + first sample rollup
units.estimated_loc: ~300 LOC + ~150 LOC suite data + ~120 LOC tests

units.title: Long-horizon plan tracker — Hermes Atlas Plans pattern
units.description: Hermes Atlas tracks N-week commitments via natural-language plan + auto-derived milestone-progress. PRISM has milestone envelopes but no auto-derived plan-from-prose path. Build `planTrackerEngine` that ingests a natural-language plan (e.g. an operator goal statement), extracts (deliverables, dependencies, est-LOC, est-effort), proposes an envelope skeleton, surfaces to operator. Sister to the existing `pickerEngine` but driven by prose intake rather than next-best-unit selection. Operator-gated promote NEVER writes the envelope directly.
units.exit_criteria: engine + dispatcher action + 6 prose-intake tests + sample envelope skeleton

units.title: Excel — read shop tool-library `.xlsx` → tribal-corpus tool entries
units.description: Most shops keep their tool library in Excel, NOT in CAM. PRISM's tribal corpus has 3919 tips but no Excel ingest. Build `excelToolLibIngestEngine` using `xlsx` npm pkg (zero-native, pure-js). Reads a workbook, identifies sheets matching tool-library frontmatter heuristics (columns: `tool_id|diameter|flutes|coating|material_class|stickout`), maps each row to a `tribal-tip` entry with provenance `{source: 'xlsx', file, sheet, row}`. R12 fail-soft on missing columns. Operator-gated promote to `tribal-corpus.json`.
units.exit_criteria: engine + dispatcher action + 5 tests (3 sheet layouts + 2 R12-degrade) + sample JM-Die `.xlsx` ingest

units.title: Excel — write quote output `.xlsx` from QuoteToShip pipeline
units.description: Today `QuoteToShipPipeline.quote()` returns JSON; ops-team manually retypes into shop Excel. Build `excelQuoteRenderEngine` that takes a `QuoteResult` and renders a customer-facing `.xlsx` with sheets: `Summary`, `Line Items`, `Setup Operations`, `Material`, `Quality Plan`. Uses `xlsx` write-side. Template-driven (one-template-per-customer-class via `mcp-server/data/quote-templates/*.xlsx`). Roundtrip-safe so the result re-ingests via U-HCAP09.
units.exit_criteria: engine + dispatcher action + 4 tests + 1 sample quote.xlsx

units.title: Excel — read customer quote history `.xlsx` → ActualCost + QuoteEstimator priors
units.description: Huge cold-start win for new PrismApp customers. Most shops have years of `.xlsx` quote history. Build `excelQuoteHistoryIngestEngine` that reads N quote files, extracts (part_id, material, qty, est_cost, actual_cost, lead_time), seeds `QuoteEstimator` Bayesian priors per customer + per part-family. R12 fail-soft on unrecognized layouts. Operator-gated; surfaces a confidence per import.
units.exit_criteria: engine + dispatcher action + 4 tests + sample JM-Die history ingest

units.title: Obsidian native PRISM plugin — master-index hits + /system-viz inline
units.description: Obsidian has a Plugin API (TypeScript, distributed via BRAT or Obsidian Catalog). Today PRISM feeds Obsidian one-way (memory-feed Stop hook). With a native plugin, operators get: (a) inline master-index hit cards on hover over any `[[backlink]]`, (b) command palette for `prism_session:master_index_query`, (c) right-pane /system-viz embed (iframe to localhost:8765), (d) frontmatter-driven dispatcher buttons. Ship as `obsidian-plugin/` subdir with own package.json + main.ts + manifest.json.
units.exit_criteria: plugin scaffold + 4 commands + manifest + README + 1 sample install

units.title: Qdrant Discovery API + SPLADE sparse vectors — better retrieval than dense-only
units.description: Sister to U-HMEMV09 (general Qdrant migration). This unit adds the TWO highest-leverage advanced features: (a) Discovery API for example-based 'find more like these' with negative examples — operator picks 3 'good' tribal tips and 1 'bad' to refine retrieval; (b) SPLADE sparse-vector embeddings — Qdrant 1.10 native sparse+dense in one collection, drop-in replacement for the hand-rolled BM25-lite in `master-index-search-lib.mjs`. Brute-force fallback preserved.
units.exit_criteria: engine + 2 dispatcher actions + ≥5 tests + recall@K benchmark vs U-HMEMV09 baseline

units.title: Council/debate protocol — formal multi-agent debate w/ rebuttals (octopus extension)
units.description: Octopus has 5-voice consensus today, but no formal debate — each voice fires once. Hermes Council mode runs N rounds: round 1 each voice proposes, round 2 each rebuts the strongest other, round 3 each updates given rebuttals, round 4 vote. Build `debateProtocolEngine` extending octopus-input-curator. ROUND_COUNT configurable (default 3). Operator-gated promote; advisory output.
units.exit_criteria: engine + integration with octopus-with-hermes-rag.mjs + 4 debate tests + sample 3-round transcript

units.title: Active learning — auto-edit slot-soul prompt based on outcomes
units.description: U-HRP05 (slot-soul evolution drafts) proposes refuse-rule candidates but doesn't compile them. Build `slotSoulCompilerEngine` that takes accepted draft candidates + outcome ledger, proposes minimal-diff edits to the actual slot-soul markdown (refuse_list additions, voice tweaks). NEVER auto-writes the soul; emits a unified diff for operator review. Hermes 'self-improving prompt' pattern but operator-gated.
units.exit_criteria: engine + dispatcher action + 5 diff-generation tests + sample diff preview

units.title: Excel add-in (Office.js) — Excel ribbon → PRISM dispatcher client
units.description: Office.js Excel add-in turns Excel into a PSN client. Ribbon buttons surface: master-index-query, prism_calc actions (cutting force, speed/feed), QuoteToShip output (write current sheet as quote-input). Manifest-distributed via shop's M365 admin or sideload. Web-pane content from a local PRISM REST server (separate unit later). Pure shell + manifest in this unit; functionality lights up as REST surface lands.
units.exit_criteria: add-in scaffold + 3 ribbon buttons (stubs) + manifest + sideload doc

units.title: Federated tribal learning — privacy-preserving aggregate signals across customers
units.description: Each shop's tribal corpus stays local. But aggregate signals (e.g. 'drill X works well in tool steel across 14 shops') promote to a shared tribal layer via differential-privacy aggregation. PRISM's no-public-H: doctrine respected — only k-anonymized hash signals leave the local boundary. Build `federatedTribalAggregator` + opt-in operator gate. Sister to closed-loop learning.
units.exit_criteria: lib + opt-in toggle + DP-aggregation tests + sample 3-shop synthetic dataset

units.title: agentskills.io skill recipe registry — import + dedup vs PRISM skill surface
units.description: Hermes pulls skill recipes from `agentskills.io`. PRISM has 174 commands but no community-recipe import. Build `skillRecipeImportEngine` that fetches a recipe URL, validates schema, runs duplicationGuardEngine against existing skills, surfaces matches/conflicts to operator. Operator-gated promote NEVER auto-installs a recipe. Source can be agentskills.io OR an internal PRISM-skills marketplace (future Hermes-MemoryProvider compliance path).
units.exit_criteria: engine + dispatcher action + 4 import-flow tests + 1 sample recipe import (dry-run)
